## License

We want these materials to be reused, taught, and built upon. Two licenses apply:

| What | License | You may |
|---|---|---|
| **Teaching materials** — text, slides, figures, exercises | [CC-BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | Share and adapt, including commercially, **with attribution** |
| **Code** — scripts, site source | [MIT](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) | Use, modify, and redistribute freely, keeping the notice |

In short: use anything here, adapt it for your own teaching or research, and
please credit the source.

::: {.callout-note}
## Data is not licensed for reuse
The datasets remain the property of their originating studies and are used here
for teaching only. The mtDNA case study uses a **synthetic** dataset; no real
participant data is distributed with these materials.
:::

## How to cite {#citation}

If these materials informed your work, teaching, or a pipeline, please cite them:

> Choga, W.T., Aid Boudries, M., Koofhethile, C., & Sabone, P. (2026).
> *Bioinformatics, AI and Data Science — Bioinformatics Series in Botswana 2026.*
> Botswana Harvard Health Partnership.
> https://wtchoga.github.io/bioinformatics-series-botswana

**BibTeX**

```bibtex
@misc{bsb2026,
  author       = {Choga, Wonderful T. and Aid Boudries, Malika and
                  Koofhethile, Catherine and Sabone, Phenyo},
  title        = {Bioinformatics, AI and Data Science --- Bioinformatics
                  Series in Botswana 2026},
  year         = {2026},
  howpublished = {\url{https://wtchoga.github.io/bioinformatics-series-botswana}},
  note         = {Botswana Harvard Health Partnership}
}
```

A machine-readable [`CITATION.cff`](https://github.com/wtchoga/bioinformatics-series-botswana/blob/bhl-customisation/CITATION.cff)
is included in the repository.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Get a DOI
Archiving a release on [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/) mints a permanent DOI you
can cite in papers and grant reports. Once minted, add it to `CITATION.cff` and
this page, and a DOI badge will render here automatically.
:::
